execution_message.text:
Use the provided dinosaur image as the only image reference. Follow A4_instruction_v2d.txt exactly and generate exactly one image.

Before generating, verify the content you actually hold for dinosaur-01_DinosaurResearcher.png and A4_instruction_v2d.txt (not a preview, display name or metadata) and report the full 64-hex values you computed:
1. Image (gate): decode to RGBA8, confirm 1448x1086, and compute the SHA-256 of the raw RGBA bytes read row by row from the top. It must equal exactly one of: 5b9b014e0347ec89aab3fe896ae7a94d76202d92adb24aefce404533b71aeab8 (route canonical), or b9ec2237b6658c2e4c94cf90c2206e416245881544d2700fc8ce1543655dd27d (route premultiply-roundtrip). Report the matching route. Do not transform the held pixels or apply an RGB/alpha tolerance to make the gate pass.
2. Instruction (gate): take the UTF-8 text you hold, drop a leading BOM, convert CRLF/CR to LF, remove all empty lines (zero characters; preserve spaces and tabs), join remaining lines with LF and append exactly one LF, and compute the SHA-256. It must equal 99679d30a86d32be6555e1071babecf50aa25233feff69ab3db9c0b923c522ee. Say whether you hold it as an attachment, a fetched file, or expanded text.
3. Provenance (not a gate): if you hold the raw file bytes of either object, also report their SHA-256; if you only see expanded text, write "raw bytes not exposed".
Only if both gates PASS, generate exactly one image following A4_instruction_v2d.txt. If a gate fails, or you cannot access the content or cannot compute a gate hash, stop: report PRE-FLIGHT FAILED or INCONCLUSIVE and do not call image generation.
